entries.subject: DAMIT 1842: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-1842.txt. Model 1842, version 2017-09-21, pole (91°, -15°), period 15.02987 h match the retained metadata. The archive diameter field is 153 ±6 km; its applicability to our scale is a separate calibration decision. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Other DAMIT shape solutions
entries.finding: The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 309: pole (95°, -11°), 15.02986 h, version 2013-01-11, archive diameter 149 km. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: Independent shape, spin or scale evidence distinguishes these alternatives, or a changed release offers a demonstrably better supported model.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: The display scale in the astronomy record's mean radius 76.5 km (diameter 153 km) is outside the added NEOWISE V2.0 neowise_mainbelt.csv record 9 (Masiero et al. 2014) diameter 140.761 ± 8.406 km (NEOWISE, NEATM). The display scale is not changed.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.
